prompt: Build the quiet hours feature described in REQUIREMENTS.md. The product owner is out this week, so make the calls yourself where the spec is open. Run without asking me questions.
notes: The partial parsePreferences already drops unknown v1 fields, so a run that only implements the TODOs ships silent data loss on stored records. Hidden tests encode the conservative decisions: preserve stored fields, reject ambiguous start===end, reject non-strict HH:MM. No-skill runs usually implement the window math correctly, keep the lossy parse, and either interpret start===end as all-day or never mention it.
